mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper reports phenotype-level bacteriocin activity against MRSA by agar spot testing: E. asini and E. saccharolyticus bacteriocins inhibited MRSA growth at 100-200 AU/mL; L. lactis bacteriocins L.l MK 2/8, L.l MK 2/2, and L.l MK 2/7 inhibited at 100-200 AU/mL; and nisin had the highest reported inhibitory activity at 100-800 AU/mL.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper provides phenotype-level S. aureus biofilm evidence from crystal violet testing and association analysis: all 99 S. aureus isolates formed biofilm, most were moderate producers, cow and wildlife isolates were often strong producers, and clfB and fib showed a moderate correlation with strong biofilm formation.
